Name: Coffee Mod - simple and customizable
Author: BoogieBest
Description:
[center]works with new SDV 1.5


What does it do: (see pictures)
Changes 4 things. Just quality of life improvments here, no cheating or rebalancing.


- Triple Shot Espresso recipe uses now 15 beans instead of 3 coffee. (so no intermediate coffee brewing required)
- Coffee is now labeled as "Cooking" for game logic (e.g. Triple Shot Espresso already was like that)
- Adds Coffee recipe to the kitchen. So no need to brew it in a ... barrel? lol. Hell no. Now you can make coffee .... brace yourself ... in the KITCHEN! Can you handle the immersion? Recipe is 5 beans a coffee like the original one. Recipe unlocked at Level 3 Farming.
- Adds Green Tea recipe to the kitchen. Recipe unlocked at level 8 Farming.


INSTALLATION:
1. make sure to download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. download the  Coffee_Mod.rar
3. unzip/extract it
4. place the "[CP]Boogie Coffee Mod" folder into your Mods folder.
5. feedback is welcome, enjoy :)!

DEINSTALLATION:
1. delete the "[CP] Boogie Coffee Mod" folder inside your mods.

COMPATIBILITY:
Should be fine with everyhting.
